source.title: Bitcoin Dumps as Democrats Take Congress! Now What?
source.description:
Bitcoin dumps to $75,000 as Democrats take control of Congress, the AI stock market bubble cracks, and fears of another massive government bailout grow. Is this Bitcoin crash the beginning of a larger financial crisis, or will Washington respond with more Federal Reserve liquidity, money printing, and inflation? From Trump's divided government and America's exploding national debt to a shocking banking crisis in Paraguay, we examine what comes next for Bitcoin, financial markets, and your money.

sentences.text: Buy Bitcoin and sail above the politics.

before.text: Within hours of the Binance hack, tether and circle froze about $2.4 billion of stable coins.
A stable coin, remember, is still a dollar?
And somebody else holds the off switch.
So is a Democratic Congress bullish or bearish for Bitcoin?
Over the next few days, it's messy.
Over the next few years, I think it's very bullish.
Groman just told you the slow road.
which is keeping real rates deeply negative, is really good for Bitcoin.
And with a divided government, the slow road is the one that's open.
Big new laws are stuck, but the debt keeps growing on autopilot.
And the Fed doesn't need a single vote from Congress to print more money.
The last three midterms all ended in divided government too.
And the debt went from about $18 trillion to more than $40 trillion anyway.
A year after each of those midterms, Bitcoin was higher.
And in every one of those years, it also dropped somewhere between 15 % and half along the way.
So don't let a red Thursday shake you out.
And whoever you voted for, be careful about putting your hope in a party or a politician.
Red or blue, nobody's printing less dollars.

after.text: So tell me in the comments.
Is a Democratic Congress bullish or bearish for Bitcoin over the next two years?
And when the AI trade finally breaks, where does the money run?
Gold, Bitcoin, or back into stocks once the government starts buying?
If you got value to this, don't forget to hit the like button, share it with a friend who's ready to panic sell, and subscribe to Simply Bitcoin for more analysis like this every day.
This is TruthBlock with Simply Bitcoin.
Thanks for hanging out with me, and I'll see you next week.
